mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals a stable monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors benefit from stable pricing and predictable economic conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeds 3% annually and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in a single month, it signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate strong economic growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annual growth > 3% and HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a single month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000, signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% suggests accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors benefit from cheap borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
